scope: Broaden modeler evidence routes by separating a bounded open-source ACIS-to-mesh projection from a documented commercial DXF ACIS consumer; refine existing S2.3/S5/S8 composed gates only.

method.kind: Current project-authored API documentation and official vendor documentation reviewed through public project pages
limitations: Documentation establishes advertised or documented route behavior, not successful acceptance of libdxfrw-produced output.
SOLIDWORKS is proprietary; no license, evaluation, installation, or runtime was used or authorized.
ezdxf is both an ACIS control author and parser/projection route, so those roles are not independent evidence.

evidence.route: ezdxf 1.4.5 ACIS mesh projection and mesh-derived authoring
evidence.observation: The API says mesh_from_body emits only flat polygonal faces and loses faces without straight boundaries; vertices_from_body gives exact bounds only for straight-edged polyhedra. body_from_mesh can author version-dependent SAT/SAB, merges coincident vertices, treats a mesh as closed when every edge has two adjacent faces, and can represent separated mesh components as separate ACIS lumps.
evidence.planUse: Use only as an optional pinned carrier/polyhedral-control route. Include curved-face and multi-component controls, report projection loss and component counts, and do not use mesh output or vertex bounds as B-rep semantic evidence.

evidence.observation: Vendor documentation describes extracting embedded ACIS from DXF into a part, or an assembly for multiple bodies/assemblies, and lists DXF 3D import from AutoCAD R14 onward. It explicitly excludes wireframe import and says this is not a 2D-to-3D converter. The documentation does not establish runtime acceptance of libdxfrw output, SAT/SAB dialect coverage for the exact generated payloads, or preservation of history/AcDs relationships.
evidence.planUse: Admit only as an optional exact-version consumer check at the existing composed milestone, if already installed and licensed. Capture importer mode, prompts, warnings, body/assembly disposition, validity, independent analytic dimensions, units, and hashes; isolate wireframe-only as a documented unsupported negative control.

evidence.route: LibreCAD and open-source parser scope boundary
evidence.observation: This research adds no evidence that a 2D consumer or an open-source DXF parser/projection route semantically consumes arbitrary ACIS B-rep. The additional SOLIDWORKS candidate is proprietary and cannot count as open-source parser or kernel evidence.
evidence.planUse: Keep 2D API/source compatibility, carrier preservation, mesh projection, and semantic solid acceptance as independent outcomes. Do not propagate one application's result to other consumers.

planDelta.testAndArtifactPolicy: Fast generated local tests remain the ordinary implementation gate; external runs occur only at the existing composed checkpoint and generated artifacts stay outside the repository.
